name: etherpad-apb
description: Deploys Etherpad Lite collaborative note-taking web application backed by a MariaDB database on OpenShift. Provisions DeploymentConfigs, Services, a Route, and PVCs with bind credential support.

name: hastebin-apb
description: Deploys Hastebin pastebin-style web application with a Memcached backend on OpenShift. Uses a dual-container DeploymentConfig with ConfigMap-based configuration injection.

name: jenkins-apb
description: Deploys Jenkins CI/CD server on OpenShift with optional persistence, OpenShift OAuth integration, optional S2I custom builds, and configurable memory limits. Creates Services, a TLS-terminated Route, a ServiceAccount, and a RoleBinding.

name: mediawiki123-apb
description: Deploys MediaWiki 1.23 on OpenShift using a route-first provisioning pattern to capture the hostname for the site server environment variable. Provisions a Route, PVC, DeploymentConfig, and Service.

name: nginx-oss-apb
description: Deploys an Nginx Open Source reverse proxy/load balancer on OpenShift with optional upstream load balancing and configurable algorithms. Nginx configuration is injected via a Jinja2-templated ConfigMap.

name: pyzip-demo-apb
description: Deploys a minimal Python ZIP code demo web application on OpenShift with no parameters, persistent storage, or bind support. Creates only a Route, Service, and DeploymentConfig.

name: pyzip-demo-db-apb
description: Deploys a PostGIS-enabled PostgreSQL database on OpenShift to back the pyzip-demo application, with database seeding from bundled geospatial SQL files. Bindable — exposes five connection credentials via service binding.
